outlook.statement: The Company expects to perform reasonably well subject to prevailing market conditions and fluctuations in the exchange rate.
The price and demand of various chemicals undergo fluctuations. Similarly, there are fluctuations in the foreign currency rates. Hence, there is an inherent risk in trading activities.

risks: Fluctuations in price and demand of chemicals
Asset volatility in defined benefit plans
Changes in bond yields affecting plan liabilities
Life expectancy increases affecting plan liabilities
Foreign currency exchange rate risk (USD exposure)
Credit risk from trade receivables and guarantees
Liquidity risk managed through reserves and banking facilities
Foreign exchange risk on import of Vinyl Acetate Monomer (VAM)
Commodity price risk (though company states no exposure in Commodities Market)
